$schemaNote: Contract for KernelSU-v330/manager/app/src/main/assets/hiding/manifest.json (pack shape + manager-side consumer semantics). Do not invent fields or categories: the packaging script and the manager both rely on this file.

$revision.reason: Module versions were refreshed and one extra module that MUST install first was added; the previously circled module was removed. Data tables below were re-synced to the regenerated pack. NO field was added, removed or renamed; the entry contract above is unchanged.
$revision.orderTable: hybrid_mount=5 added (module.prop declares metamodule=1 => must be first), Violet removed
$revision.modesTable: hybrid_mount added as null (= both modes; module.prop carries no mode evidence, same rule as before), Violet removed
$revision.manifestSha256: NOT pinned here: every regeneration changes generatedAt, so the hash is compared against a value recorded per build outside the repository (and against the in-APK copy during verification).

manifest.totalBytes: MUST equal the exact sum of entries[*].sizeBytes

entries.id: string, unique. Modules = module id; pathmask = <moduleId>-<branch>; detector = detector-<packageName>
entries.name: string (display name)
entries.author: string
entries.asset: string, path relative to the assets root, e.g. hiding/modules/zygisksu.zip or hiding/detectors/io.github.vvb2060.mahoshojo.apk
entries.sizeBytes: integer, MUST equal the on-disk file length
entries.sha256: 64 lowercase hex chars, MUST equal Get-FileHash output
entries.sourceFile: string (original file in 隐藏环境资源包)
entries.modes: array of "lkm"|"gki"; ABSENT or [] means BOTH are fine (safe default)
entries.order: integer, smaller installs first; default 100 when absent

parserRules.note: HidingPackRepository.toEntry() silently drops unknown keys, so the parser MUST read modes+order. Missing/non-array modes -> empty set (both). Missing/non-integer order -> 100.

modesTable.evidence: pathmask module.prop self-describes 'Android LKM path masking' (carries pathmask.ko, insmod from service.sh) => lkm. susfs4ksu module.prop says 'compiled with patched kernel source' => gki (needs a susfs-patched kernel). All other entries: NO evidence yet => leave modes absent (both); when a module.prop does not settle it, keep the modes default.

runtimeMode.source: Natives.isLkmMode (Natives.kt:43) gated by KernelVersion.isGKI(); mirror ui/viewmodel/HomeViewModel.kt:48-60 which uses a tri-state lkmMode: Boolean?

states.Lkm: !kernelVersion.isGKI() is false AND isLkmMode is true
states.GkiBuiltIn: !kernelVersion.isGKI() is false AND isLkmMode is false
states.Unknown: !kernelVersion.isGKI() is true (mode not reportable) -> filtering MUST be a no-op and the page MUST say so on screen

runtimeMode.never: do NOT gate on a bare Boolean defaulting to false; that would show GKI-only items to LKM users

installStrategy.module: execKsud("module install <absolute cache path>") - one at a time, serialized
installStrategy.pathmask: same as module, and EXACTLY ONE variant (the KMI match) may be in a batch; the six variants share moduleId=pathmask and overwrite each other
installStrategy.detector: ROOT FIRST: su -c "pm install -r -t --user 0 <absolute cache path>" (exit code is the verdict); if that fails, fall back to FileProvider ACTION_VIEW + poll PackageManager for packageName, 60s timeout. The root path needs NO REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES; the fallback needs the user to have allowed unknown sources, so never report success on the fallback without a positive PackageManager hit.

oneKeyHide.baseSet: visible category=module entries whose id is in {hybrid_mount, zygisksu, tricky_store, hma_oss_zygisk}. hybrid_mount is a metamodule (module.prop declares metamodule=1): order=5 makes it the FIRST step; do not reorder it after another module.
oneKeyHide.pathmask: exactly one entry = recommendedIds ∩ visible entries (empty -> skip and report 无匹配内核分支)
oneKeyHide.optionLsposed: extra checkbox; appends zygisk_lsposed and REQUIRES zygisksu to be in the set (disable the checkbox otherwise)
oneKeyHide.dedupe: by moduleId, keeping the entry with the smallest order, then sort ascending by order
oneKeyHide.terminal: after the last step the UI MUST state 需重启后生效; during the run the button is disabled, states refresh per step and each step prints 第 n/m 步 · <name> · 成功|失败:<error>
oneKeyHide.serialized: steps run one after another (shared root shell) - never concurrently

frozenLiterals.note: The UI and its assertions depend on these exact strings; the string keys use the prefixes hide_environment_onekey_* / hide_environment_quick_* / hide_environment_mode_*.

hand-editing manifest.json (it must be regenerated by _tools/sync-hiding-pack.ps1)
adding entries for keybox.xml / target.txt (includes.keybox and includes.data stay false)
modifying manager/app/src/test/** or manager/app/src/androidTest/** (do not create them either)
touching the read-only source pack directory (隐藏环境资源包)
